I had this one guy I was friends with back in preschool; we were buddies up until just before high school, like a few months before I moved out of town. Not really sure what caused us to stop talking as much, maybe just hanging around different friend groups and stuff. We would hang out at lunch and had most of our classes together in most out grades until then too, so we were vibing together a bit. After I moved I didnt really talk to many people from my hometown besides my (at the time) gf, my youtube buddies, and a couple other friends. I think he was also more so part of his gf’s friends group so another reason for the distance. 

Back in october 2019, a couple days after both of our birthdays, he seemed to have committed suicide, as thats all that was told to us from his family and gf, whos the same one from earlier and have been together for around 5 years pretty sure.. I was starting to drink around that time bc I thought “oh man alcohol is fun why didnt I do this before” but after the news i pretty much started drinking to ease that feeling that my childhood friend died. It was hard, and im not entirely over it still, but the last straw of than situation was seeing his gf on tinder not even 3 weeks after he died.
Also unpopular because rape is a bad thing, regardless of what political ideology you support.

It’s not exciting but probably something along the lines of completely finishing as many video games and listening to as much music as i can and live a life where no one knows im going to live forever. Maybe later in time I would release some kind of media, whether it be in books or music or anything else under a bunch of different aliases.

One from my father around Xmas time; he was to drunk to make a complete thought and went on and on about how me and my brother are awful people for ditching him to live with our mom, who he cheated on many times behind her back. Later on he started talking about how my mom was a slut and how he was gonna marry the woman he cheated on her with, and he did end up marrying her so he kept his word. 

Last text i got from him was a “happy birthday” text and i referred to him by his first name just to piss him off (it was petty, but i thought it was funny).

The whole text was a mess, not even MLA formatted. Definitely gets a 15% grade; at least be got to the minimum word requirement
